en.headline: Police arrest two women over alleged child abuse after girl's video plea
en.dek: An 11-year-old girl in Wong Tai Sin was found with swollen limbs after posting videos seeking help; her grandmother and a domestic helper have been detained.
body: Police arrested a 61-year-old local woman and a 43-year-old Indonesian domestic helper in Wong Tai Sin on Friday on suspicion of ill-treatment or neglect of a child.

The arrests followed the circulation of videos in which the 11-year-old girl appeared to plead for help from inside her home. The girl was found with red and swollen limbs and was taken in a conscious state to Queen Elizabeth Hospital on Thursday before being transferred to the Hong Kong Children’s Hospital.

According to police, the case was referred by the Social Welfare Department. The two suspects are being detained for further enquiries. The girl has not been named, and no further charges have been announced at this stage.

zh.headline: 警方黃大仙拘兩女涉虐兒 十一歲女童拍片求救
zh.dek: 一名十一歲女童在社交媒體上載影片求救後，被發現手腳紅腫；其外祖母及一名印尼外傭已被警方拘捕。
body: 警方周五在黃大仙拘捕一名六十一歲本地女子及一名四十三歲印尼籍外傭，涉嫌對所看管的兒童虐待或忽略。
事件源於網上流傳的影片，顯示該名十一歲女童在家中向鏡頭求救。女童手腳出現紅腫，周四清醒被送往伊利沙伯醫院，其後轉往香港兒童醫院接受治理。
警方表示，案件由社會福利署轉介。兩名被捕人士現正被扣留調查。女童身份未有公開，目前亦未有進一步控罪宣布。
